bear_assumptions: USD 4.00 normalized forward GAAP EPS at 30x as AI and cloud growth decelerate, one large customer slows deployments, gross margin remains pressured by mix, supply commitments produce losses and the premium multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: USD 4.80 normalized forward GAAP EPS at 38x as Q3 guidance is substantially achieved, AI-networking demand remains durable, software and operating leverage support earnings, and the multiple recognizes both business quality and concentration risk.
bull_assumptions: USD 5.60 normalized forward GAAP EPS at 45x as sustained AI-cluster wins, software attachment, operating leverage and supply execution drive per-share earnings while the market retains a premium multiple.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower entry price or higher auditable per-share earnings clears expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade if Ethernet loses share, a major customer slows or internalizes networking, Broadcom supply or purchase commitments impair margins, inventory losses emerge, or per-share earnings decelerate materially.
